Neptune Laundry offers a dedicated app for scheduling residential laundry pickup and delivery. The app is available on both iOS through the App Store and Android through Google Play, and allows you to book a pickup time, select preferences, and receive updates throughout the process.

The pickup and delivery service is operated from our nearby 489 Saratoga Street location in East Boston, which covers the Lynn, MA area and surrounding communities. No sorting is needed before the pickup. Clothes are returned clean, dried, and folded on delivery.

Have you been managing laundry pickups through phone calls or hard-to-navigate websites? The Neptune Laundry app puts the full scheduling process in one place on your phone. Download it, use code FIRST20 on your first order for $20 off, and let the service come to you.

Residential laundry pickup and delivery through Neptune Laundry requires no sorting on your end before the pickup. Simply place your clothes in any bag, schedule a pickup time online or through the Neptune Laundry app, and an associate will collect the laundry directly from your door.

This service is operated from our nearby 489 Saratoga Street location in East Boston, which covers the Lynn, MA area and surrounding communities. Your clothes are returned cleaned, dried, and folded, and are ready to go straight into the drawer when delivered back to you.

Have you been avoiding laundry pickup services because you assumed preparation and sorting were required? With Neptune Laundry, the process starts when you close the bag. Schedule your first pickup through the app and use code FIRST20 for $20 off your first order.

Using a laundromat can be more cost-effective than doing laundry at home, depending on how often you wash and the size of your loads. Home washing machines use electricity, hot water, and detergent on every cycle, and older machines consume significantly more per load than modern commercial units.

At Neptune Laundromat on 822 Western Avenue in Lynn, MA, dryers are always free of charge. That removes one of the most significant per-load costs for home laundry users. The ozone system also reduces the need for extra detergent or repeated cycles to fully eliminate odors from heavily soiled items.

Have you ever added up the monthly cost of doing laundry at home, including water, electricity, detergent, and appliance wear? The comparison with a laundromat may be closer than expected. Stop by Neptune Laundromat at 822 Western Avenue in Lynn any day of the year to run your next load.
